description: Combines a text field with a date picker and a time picker.

props.allowedDates: Restricts which dates can be selected or typed.
props.datePickerProps: Props passed to the date picker, such as `first-day-of-week` or `show-week`.
props.defaultTime: Time as a 24-hour `HH:mm` string used when only the date is picked or typed.
props.format: Hour cycle used for typing and display, `ampm` or `24hr`. Falls back to the hour cycle of the current locale.
props.hideActions: Hide the Cancel and OK buttons, and automatically update the value when a date or time is selected.
props.inputFormat: Format of the date part for manual input. Use yyyy, mm, dd with separators '.', '-', '/' (e.g. 'yyyy-mm-dd', 'dd/mm/yyyy').
props.location: Specifies the picker's location. Can combine by using a space separated string.
props.max: Latest selectable date and time as a `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` string. A date without a time means the end of that day. The time picker applies it only on the day of **max**.
props.menu: Controls the picker menu. `date` or `time` opens that picker, `true` opens the date picker.
props.min: Earliest selectable date and time as a `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` string. A date without a time means the start of that day. The time picker applies it only on the day of **min**.
props.modelValue: The selected date and time as a local `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` string, the same as the value of a native `datetime-local` input. It does not depend on the date adapter. Values with a time zone or offset are rejected.
props.openOnFocus: Open the picker menu when the input receives focus.
props.timePickerProps: Props passed to the time picker, such as `scrollable`.
props.updateOn: Specifies when the text input should update the model value. If empty, the text field will go into read-only state.
